project_name: A Bayesian Approach to Predict Solubility Parameters
summary: Solubility governs behavior across pharmaceuticals, coatings, organic semiconductors, and chemical synthesis, but is difficult to predict because of the complex solute-solvent interplay. This project set out to model Hansen solubility parameters with Gaussian-process regression trained on chemical descriptors and sigma profiles, using the recently released GAUCHE framework (Gaussian processes for chemistry, built on GPyTorch and BoTorch) to compare a range of molecular kernels, including fingerprint-based kernels. The aim was to establish a reproducible GP/BO benchmark for solubility prediction and to identify which kernels perform best on this task. (No recorded video was submitted for this project; this summary is based on the team's project page.)
